image_axes: x right, y down; car drives toward +y (down the image)

camera.method: phase correlation of the right sidewalk strip (x 860-1079) vs frame 0

orange_car.description: orange sports car seen from above, front (headlights) pointing down the image, in the left lane next to the left curb. Only vehicle and only moving object.
orange_car.reference_point: cx_best_px, cy_best_px = centre of car body bounding box (vehicle root assumed at body centre, top view)

size_px.length_note: median of unclipped frames 17-90 (286-293; larger values in early frames include motion blur)
size_px.width_note: body width ~108-112 px (mirrors excluded/dark); height not observable (top view)

orange_car.motion_summary_px: straight down the lane; per-frame step decreases smoothly from ~18.6 px (frame 8) to ~3.5 px (frame 90); slight leftward drift x 356 -> 348 over the clip

left_curb_edge.note: bright curb strip between left sidewalk and road

left_solid_lane_line.note: white edge line just right of left curb (worn)

centre_dashed_line.note: white dashed centre line (worn; dash pattern irregular)

right_lane_line.note: pale yellowish/white line near right curb

static_objects.lane_width_px: left line to centre line centres: 570-338.5 = 231.5; centre to right line: 801.5-570 = 231.5

lamp_post_upper.note: black hexagonal lamp head on left sidewalk, arm pointing right to post base at ~(251,465)

lamp_post_lower.note: second lamp, arm goes up-right to post base at ~(251,909)

fire_hydrant.note: small white/rust hydrant beside lower lamp (left sidewalk, x<272) - orange-ish, excluded from car mask

sidewalks.note: paving slabs; grass strip at far left x<20

static_objects.road_patches: dark patched/pothole areas around the centre line (x~505-560) and right lane (x~600-830); static texture

events.car_decelerating: throughout the clip, smooth (roughly constant) decrease of per-frame step; car does not stop by frame 90
events.motion_end: none within clip (still moving ~3.5 px/frame at frame 90)
